title: 两张票 Liǎng zhāng piào — Two wrong tickets
summary: A birthday film outing is nearly lost to a phone screen and rescued by a printed receipt.
attribution: Original content authored for this project.

body.speaker: 旁白
body.zh: 周奶奶七十二岁生日，全家去看电影。
body.py: Zhōu nǎinai qīshí èr suì shēngrì, quán jiā qù kàn diànyǐng.
body.en: It is Grandma Zhou seventy-second birthday and the whole family goes to the movies.

body.speaker: 旁白
body.zh: 孙女在网上买了六张票，付了钱，然后截了一张图。
body.py: sūnnǚ zài wǎng shàng mǎi le liù zhāng piào, fù le qián, ránhòu jié le yì zhāng tú.
body.en: Her granddaughter buys six tickets online, pays, and then takes a screenshot.

body.speaker: 旁白
body.zh: 到了影院，取票机上什么也没有。
body.py: dào le yǐngyuàn, qǔ piào jī shàng shénme yě méiyǒu.
body.en: At the cinema the ticket machine shows nothing at all.

body.speaker: 工作人员
body.py: qǐng bǎ qǔ piào mǎ gěi wǒ kànkan.
body.en: Please let me see your pickup code.

body.speaker: 孙女
body.zh: 我的手机截图上没有那一行。
body.py: wǒ de shǒujī jiétú shàng méiyǒu nà yì háng.
body.en: That line is not on my screenshot.

body.speaker: 工作人员
body.zh: 你订的是明天晚上七点。
body.py: nǐ dìng de shì míngtiān wǎnshang qī diǎn.
body.en: You booked tomorrow at seven in the evening.

body.speaker: 孙女
body.zh: 对不起，我把日期看错了。
body.py: duìbuqǐ, wǒ bǎ rìqī kàn cuò le.
body.en: I am sorry, I read the date wrong.

body.speaker: 旁白
body.zh: 奶奶的生日一年只有一次，大家都急了。
body.py: nǎinai de shēngrì yì nián zhǐ yǒu yí cì, dàjiā dōu jí le.
body.en: A birthday comes once a year and everybody starts to worry.

body.speaker: 工作人员
body.zh: 今天下午还有一场，只剩四张，靠后面。
body.py: jīntiān xiàwǔ hái yǒu yì chǎng, zhǐ shèng sì zhāng, kào hòumian.
body.en: There is still one show this afternoon, only four seats left, at the back.

body.speaker: 爸爸
body.zh: 我们不要第三排了，后面也可以。
body.py: wǒmen bú yào dì sān pái le, hòumian yě kěyǐ.
body.en: We will skip row three, the back is fine.

body.speaker: 旁白
body.zh: 买票的时候，他把小票拿在手里，念了两遍日期。
body.py: mǎi piào de shíhou, tā bǎ xiǎopiào ná zài shǒu lǐ, niàn le liǎng biàn rìqī.
body.en: Buying the new tickets, he holds the receipt and reads the date twice.

body.speaker: 奶奶
body.zh: 我坐后面看得更清楚，我喜欢这样。
body.py: wǒ zuò hòumian kàn de gèng qīngchu, wǒ xǐhuan zhèyàng.
body.en: I see better from the back, I like it this way.

body.speaker: 孙女
body.zh: 以后我念给你听，不再只发一张图。
body.py: yǐhòu wǒ niàn gěi nǐ tīng, bú zài zhǐ fā yì zhāng tú.
body.en: From now on I will read it aloud to you, not just send a picture.

blocks.title: Words in this story
body: 取票码 qǔ piào mǎ — ticket pickup code
只剩 zhǐ shèng — only ... left
靠后面 kào hòumian — toward the back

blocks.body: Think about it: The family changes one habit at the end. Which one, and why does it matter more than the seats? Write two Chinese sentences.
